In the final moments, X4 drives toward the inevitable, pursued by police and cut off from any future with X5.
His last actions are deliberate and calm.
To exonerate X5, and put all the blame on himself, he goads her into shooting him by threatening to kill X11.
He accepts his end as the only way to give meaning to his life, by saving both X5 and the child, even if X5 never fully understands what he did for her.

title: Case 39
label: Case 39
sentences: X1 is a social worker assigned to investigate the family of X2 10-year-old X3, as her grades have declined and an emotional rift with her parents has emerged.
X1 suspects that the parents have been abusing and overprotecting X4 since the day she was born, and proposes to her department to take the child away from her parents' custody.
Eventually, X1's suspicions are confirmed when X4's parents try to kill her by roasting her alive in their oven.
X1 saves X4 with the help of X5.
X4 is to be sent to a children's home, but she begs X1 to look after her instead.
With the board's agreement, X1 is assigned to care for X4 until a suitable foster family is found.
In the meantime, X4's parents are placed in a mental institution since they are no longer fit for their parental responsibility for the girl, according to the court.
After X4 moves in, strange things begin to happen around X1.
Another of X1's cases, a X6, murders his parents, and X7 informs X1 that somebody phoned X8 from her house the night before the crime.
As she is suspected of involvement in the incident, X4 undergoes a psychiatric evaluation by X1's best friend, X9.
During the session, X4 turns the evaluation around, asking X10 what his fears are and subtly threatening him.
That night, after receiving a "strange phone call" at his apartment, X10 is panicked by the sight of a mass of hornets coming out of his body.
His panic causes him to fall and break his neck on the toilet, killing him instantly.
X1 becomes suspicious about having X4 in her home, so she heads to the mental asylum to seek answers from X4's parents.
They tell her that X4 is a demon who feeds on feelings, and that they tried to kill her in an attempt to save themselves and others.
X4's father tells X1 that the only way to kill X4 is to get her to sleep.
Shortly after X1 leaves the asylum, both parents die: her mother is fatally burned, and her father is stabbed in the eye with a fork.
X7 thinks X1 should seek psychiatric help, but is later convinced when he receives a similar strange phone call in his home from X1's cellphone, which is being used by X4.

He arms himself at the police precinct to aid X1 in handling X4; however, he inadvertently and fatally shoots himself in the head with a shotgun when X4 makes him imagine he is being attacked by permanently ferocious dogs.

After realizing that her closest colleagues have been eliminated, and that the rest of her cases will be next, that night, X1 has X4 drink tea spiked with sedative, and while X4 is asleep, X1 sets fire to her house, hoping and attempting to get rid of her.
However, the girl escapes unharmed.
The police offer to escort X1 and X4 to a temporary place to stay.
As X1 follows the police cars, she suddenly takes a different route and drives at high speed, hoping to instill fear in X4.
She then drives the car off a pier.
As the car sinks, X1 struggles to lock X4 (now in her true demon form) in the trunk.
X1 then exits the car, but as she swims away, the surviving X4 grabs her leg after punching a hole through the car's taillight, in an attempt to prevent her escape.
X1 struggles to break free until X1 overcomes her strengths and fears, which causes X4 to finally let go of X1 as the car continues to sink, finally defeating X4 from the inside.
As X1 climbs back ashore, she is relieved to be rid of X4, hence bringing the case itself to a close.

title: The Lincoln Lawyer (film)
label: The Lincoln Lawyer (film)
sentences: Criminal defense attorney X1 works in X2, from the back of his black X3, chauffeured by X4.
He typically works for low-end criminals including X5, leader of a biker gang.
His ex-wife, X6, with whom he shares a daughter, is a district attorney who disapproves of his choice of clientele.
X7 is unexpectedly hired to represent X8, a wealthy X9 playboy and the son of real estate mogul X10.
X11 is accused of viciously beating prostitute X12, and surprisingly chose X7 specifically for the case.
X7 and his investigator, X13, analyze photos and evidence and find similarities to a prior case where a prostitute was killed.
X7 represented the defendant, X14, and due to the overwhelming evidence and in spite of X15's earnest proclamations of innocence, convinced him to plead guilty to avoid the death penalty.
X7 visits X15, who becomes agitated when he shows him X11's photo.
X7 realizes that X11 is likely the killer.
His own hands tied, X7 tells X16 to investigate X11.
When he gets back home, he sees that someone broke into his house.
He stumbles upon X11, who learned that X7 visited X17 earlier.

X11 nonchalantly admits to committing the murder for which X15 was convicted and says he chose X7 as counsel in order to bind X7 by attorney–client confidentiality rules and keep him from talking about either case.
He also makes veiled threats towards X7's daughter.
Later, X16 is found shot dead after leaving him a voicemail message claiming he found X15's "ticket out of jail."
X7 learns that the bullet that killed X16 matches his late father's antique.22 X18, which is missing from its box; this means X11 framed X7 for the killing.
During the trial, X7 ruthlessly cross-examines X19 and discredits her.
He also secretly sets up a known prison informant, X20, to testify against X11 with furnished information on the previous murder.
X7 is able to discredit X21's testimony, getting X11's current charges dismissed.
However, when X11 is set free, the police arrest him immediately for the previous attack based on X21's description.
X22 gives X7 a gun, acting on X7's earlier request.
X11's family gets him released due to lack of evidence and he goes to X23's home, where X7 is waiting, having monitored the tracking device still attached to X11.

X7 vows that he will not stop until X15 is freed and X11 is convicted for his crime AND for killing X24 mockingly tells him he cannot guard his family all the time; but the biker gang arrives on cue and bashes X11's luxury vehicle before beating him badly enough to send him to the hospital.
X23 discovers X16 had found a parking ticket issued to X11 near the murder victim's house, strong evidence against him.
Upon arriving home, X7 is surprised by X11's mother, who had broken in.
When X7 tells her he is going to get her son convicted of X25's murder, she says "My son didn't kill him, I did" and shoots X7 with the X18.
Hit in the midsection, X7 falls back and before X26 can fire again, he pulls his gun and kills her.
In the epilogue we learn that X15 has been released and the DA is seeking the death penalty for X11.
As X7 and X22 drive off, he is pulled over by X27 and the biker gang, whose case he takes pro bono in gratitude for their help, though he reminds X22 he will charge more for later cases.

title: Atlas Shrugged: Part II
label: Atlas Shrugged: Part II
sentences: X1 pilots an airplane in pursuit of another plane.
X2 asks herself, "Who is X3?" before apparently crashing into a mountainside.
Nine months earlier, X2 is trying to understand the abandoned prototype of an advanced motor she and her lover X4 have found.
Scientists across the country have been disappearing under mysterious circumstances, but X2 is able to locate X5, who agrees to help from an abandoned laboratory in X6.
X2's brother X7, president of the family railroad company, meets store clerk X8 and brings her to see a renowned pianist, who disappears during his performance, leaving a note asking, "Who is X3?"
Later, at X9 and X10's wedding, X2's friend X11 argues with other guests about whether money is evil, and secretly informs X12 about devastating explosions at his copper mine—the next day.
X12 spends the night with X2.
Later, he is confronted about the affair by his wife X13, but when he offers a divorce she declines, in order to maintain her position in society.
X12 sells his advanced X14 to X15's coal mining company, but refuses to sell it to the federal government, in defiance of the newly enacted "X16" law that forces businesses to sell to all buyers.
The two are charged under the law.
X2 barges into X17's office, realizes that he too is about to disappear, and understands that she is close to understanding the force behind the disappearances.
At trial, X12 defends individual freedom and the pursuit of profit, and is given only a token penalty by the court, which fears turning him into a martyr.
The government announces "X18", which freezes employment and production and requires that all patents be gifted to the government.
X12 defies this decree as well, but relents when he is blackmailed with photos of himself and X2 that would damage X2's reputation.
When X2 hears about X12's "gift" and her brother's complicity, she quits the railroad.
During her absence, a X19 train collides with a military train in a tunnel, due largely to political pressure by a passenger and human error by X2's poorly trained replacement.
This impels X2 back to her job.
X20 tries to dissuade her from returning, as he had earlier tried to talk X12 into leaving his business, but she returns anyway.
X2 takes a train to X21 to show her faith in the railway, but its engine fails.
The repair technician used to work for X22, which produced the motor X2 found.
He tells X2 how the need-based reward system in his company failed, and his coworker X3 left the company vowing to "stop the motor of the world".
X2 calls X23, who tells her that he is quitting.
X2 buys a small airplane and flies to X6 to try to dissuade him, but as she is landing, she sees him get into a plane on the airstrip.
After a pursuit in the air—the opening scene of the X24's plane crashes in a valley hidden by stealth technology.
A wounded X1 crawls to the edge of her crashed plane, where she is greeted by X3.
The film ends with a quote from X25: "Money is the barometer of a society's virtue.
But when you see that in order to produce it, you need to obtain permission from those who produce nothing...
You will know that your society is doomed.

title: The Tall Man (2012 film)
label: The Tall Man (2012 film)
sentences: X1 lives in a small town in X2 called X3.
She is the town's local nurse, widowed by her husband, who was the town's doctor.
X3 was formerly a prosperous mining town, but has become poverty-stricken.
There is little work, the school has been closed and the town has virtually vanished from the map.
During her day, X1 visits several families.
X4 and X5 live with their mother and her violent, alcoholic boyfriend, who has impregnated X5.
Despite this, their mother did not kick him out, drawing X1's ire.
Instead, she sends away X5 and her baby, whom X1 helped to deliver.
Because of her rough life, X4 is selectively mute, communicating through a journal she carries.
She also sketches things she's seen, including "the X6".
This is a local legend or urban myth surrounding a being who abducts local children who are never seen again.
X1 returns to her large home on the outskirts of X3, which she shares with her son X7 and his nanny.
She eats dinner, puts X7 to bed, and falls asleep on a couch.
She awakes to a noise downstairs, followed by a loud radio sermon.
She finds the nanny bound and gagged, then rushes to her son's bedroom, finding him gone.
While in pursuit of what the viewer believes is "the X6", it is gradually revealed that X7 is not her son at all, but rather one of the kidnapped children.
The kidnapper is actually the real mother of the boy, attempting to take back her child.
The rest of the town, skeptical of the mother's accusations, agree to give her a chance to prove her claims.
X1, with the help of X4, pursues the mother, reacquires X7, and hands him off to "the X6" in the tunnels which run under the town, left over from the defunct mine.
X4 begs her to send the X6 to take her, too.
X1 initially refuses but then relents, cautioning her to remain silent about it until the X6 comes for her.
X1 then waits in her house.
The police and X8 arrive, as does an angry mob.
The nanny hangs herself, and X1 is taken to jail, where she is despised and threatened as a child killer.
X1 admits to kidnapping and murdering the children, but the confession is later revealed to be a lie.
Soon after, X4 watches her mother engage in a drunken fight with her boyfriend, before laughing with him over it.
Disgusted, X4 walks off into a nearby field, where she finds the X6 waiting for X9's husband, who is not dead after all.
He takes her to an empty house in a nearby city, providing her with new clothes.
He then delivers her to a new family, with a new identity.

The X6 refuses payment, saying that the organization faces massive risks to rescue each child, with X1 martyring herself to save the organisation, which "rescues" young children from bad homes and places them with good ones, in an attempt to break the cycle of poverty and abuse which passes from one generation to the next.
In X10's birth mother grieves over her runaway daughter, the town continues to decline, and X1 sits in prison.
The police have given up on finding the children, thinking that X1 buried them in the tunnels which run for miles and are dangerous to traverse because of cave ins, etc.
In comparison, X4 lives in a beautiful home, where her art is encouraged, and she has the best of everything.
She has begun to talk and seems well-adjusted and happy.

As she walks to an art class, she gives a voice-over expressing love and gratitude toward her three mothers: her birth mother, whom she misses; X1, who gave her a chance at a new life; and her new mother, who is providing her with everything she could ever want.
As she crosses a park, she sees X7 with his new family, which he now accepts as his own.
(X4 thinks he and the other younger ones have forgotten and do not recognize her, but the visual cues leave it decidedly open-ended).
Despite getting her wish of a better life, she sometimes wishes to return.
X4's closing thoughts question society's implication that her new life is better.

title: The Loft (film)
label: The Loft (film)
sentences: Five married men share ownership of an upmarket loft, which they use for discreetly meeting their respective mistresses.
When the body of a murdered woman X1 is found in that loft, the men begin to suspect each other of having committed the gruesome crime, as they are the only ones with keys to the premises.
Through flashbacks, which are intertwined with scenes from the present, the story is unravelled.
The five men are: X2: architect and designer of the building where the loft is situated.
Married to X3 and father of their children, he initially suggests the five friends use the loft as a private oasis.
He is set up by the other men to be accused of the murder.
X4: a psychiatrist married to X5 and the elder maternal half-brother to siblings X6 and X7.
He is the most reluctant of the men to the loft idea and the last to accept a key; X8 eventually does so because he is attracted to X9, who eventually becomes his mistress.
X9 warns X8 not to fall in love with her because she is a prostitute, and he gives her his key as proof he does not use the loft with other women.
X10: married to X11, who is an insulin-dependent diabetic.
He discovers the body in the loft and initially calls X12 and the others over.
The police later insinuate that X13 is attracted to X12, and it is X13 who records the men's activities in the loft without their knowledge.
X14: heavy drinker and a conspicuous lecher.
He and his wife X15 separate when a woman X16 slept with on a business trip shows up at their house.
X17: half-brother to X8 and recently married to X18, the only daughter of a wealthy property developer who is also X6's boss.
X6 is a drug user who grew up in a dysfunctional household with his abusive father and is very protective of his younger sister X7.
He warns the other men off from having sex with her.

title: Tomorrowland (film)
label: Tomorrowland (film)
sentences: At the 1964 X1, young inventor X2 attempts to showcase his homemade jet pack, but it fails and does not impress the judges.
However, a mysterious girl, X3, sees potential in him.
She gives him a lapel pin marked with a “T” and directs him onto the X4 ride, where the pin triggers a hidden transport to X5 dazzling futuristic city in another dimension.
There, robots repair his jet pack, allowing him to soar through the city and join its secret community of innovators.
In the present, teenage optimist X6 continually sabotages the demolition of a X7 launch platform in hopes of saving her father’s job.
After she is arrested, she discovers a X8 pin among her belongings.
Touching it transports her to the futuristic world, but only as a projection; when the pin’s power is expended, she abruptly returns to her normal reality.
Determined to understand what she saw, X9 follows clues to a memorabilia shop in X10, where the owners attack her for information about the pin.
X3 bursts in and defeats the owners, actually X11, who self-destruct, blowing apart the shop.
After X9 and X3 steal a car, X3 reveals she is also an animatronic, purposed to find and recruit people who fit the ideals of X8.
X3 brings X9 to a now-adult X2, who is a bitter recluse living in X12.
Banished from X8 years earlier, X13 wants nothing to do with the place.
X9 discovers he has built a device predicting the imminent end of the world, but her refusal to accept that future causes the probability to drop—something X13 has never seen.
When robotic assassins arrive to eliminate them, X13 reluctantly joins X9 and X3.
Using a teleportation device, they travel to X14 and launch an old rocket hidden beneath the X15.
X13 explains that X8 was created by X16, a secret society of visionaries lead by X17, and X18, who sought a place free from political and commercial interference.
Arriving in X8, the trio finds the once‑utopian city in decline.
X19 greets them and leads them to a tachyon machine X13 invented which can view possible futures.
It has been broadcasting visions of global catastrophe to X20.
X9 realizes the machine’s warnings have become a self-fulfilling prophecy: humanity, overwhelmed by doom, simply stopped trying to prevent disaster.
X21 admits he intended the images as a wake‑up call, but when the world ignored them, he gave up and decided to let the apocalypse unfold.
X22, and X3 attempt to destroy the machine, but X21 fights to stop them.
During the struggle, X3 foresees X21 killing X13.
She sacrifices herself to save him by triggering her self‑destruct sequence.
The explosion destroys the tachyon device, and the falling wreckage kills X21.
In the aftermath, X9 and X13 take leadership of X8.
They recruit X9's father and brother, and they build a new generation of X23 animatronics.
Given X8 pins, these childlike robots set out across the world to find new dreamers, thinkers, and inventors—people capable of building a better future.

title: It Comes at Night
label: It Comes at Night
sentences: A contagious disease ravages the planet.
X1 and their teenage son X2 live a secluded lifestyle in their home, deep in the woods in an undisclosed location.
After X3's father X4 contracts the disease, they euthanise him and burn his body.
That night, they capture an intruder breaking in.
X5 ties him to a tree and places a bag over his head, leaving him there overnight to confirm he is not suffering from the disease.
The stranger, X6, explains he was searching for fresh water for his wife and young son.
X6 offers to trade some food for water.
X3 suggests taking the strangers in, on the reasoning that with more people it would be easier to defend themselves.
X5 reluctantly agrees and drives X6 to collect his family.
Along the way, they are ambushed by two men.
X5 kills them, while accusing X6 of setting him up.
X6 assuages X5's mistrust.
X5 returns with X6, his wife X7, and son X8.
After establishing their rules, which include keeping the only entrance locked with a key X5 or X3 wear around their neck, the two families establish a sense of normality and grow closer.
One day, X2's dog X9 begins barking aggressively at an unseen presence and chases it into the woods.
X2, who had followed X9, insists he heard something in the woods.
That night, X6 seemingly contradicts a story he told X5 earlier, resulting in X5's increasing distrust of X6.
That evening, X2 discovers X8 sleeping on the floor of X4's old room, suffering from a nightmare.
He also finds the front door of the house open.
The families investigate, finding a bleeding and gravely sick X9 on the floor.
They euthanise and burn the dog.
After X2 reveals the door was open, X3 suggests that a sleepwalking X8 opened the door, causing more distrust.
X5 suspects X8 is infected, and decides they should quarantine in their separate rooms to ensure no one is sick.
That evening, X2 is awakened by a nightmare about his grandfather.
The next morning, X2 overhears X8 crying constantly and X7 telling X6 they need to leave.
X2 informs his parents that he too may be infected.
X5 and X3 don protective masks and gloves, and take weapons to confront X7 and X6.
X6 draws a gun and takes X5 captive.
He insists his family is healthy, repeatedly tells X8 to keep his eyes shut and orders X5 to remove the mask.
X6 demands X5 give him a "fair share" of food and water so they can leave.
X3 and X5 overwhelm X6, and force him and his family outside.
X6 tries to beat X5 to death until X3 shoots X6, killing him.
X7 flees into the woods with X8.
X5 fires at them, killing X8, then X7.
Later, X2 awakens in bed, visibly sick.
His mother comforts him as he dies.
X5 and X3, now visibly infected, sit at the dinner table in silence.
They share a shattered, devastated look.

title: Blade Runner 2049
label: Blade Runner 2049
sentences: In X1, bioengineered humans known as replicants are still used for slave labor.
X2 (short for serial number, a X3 replicant, works for the X4 as a "blade runner", an officer who hunts and "retires" (kills) rogue replicant models.
After "retiring" replicant X5 finds a box buried under a tree at X6's farm.
It contained the remains of a female replicant who died during a caesarean section.
This demonstrates that replicants could reproduce biologically, previously thought impossible.
X2's superior, X7, fears this knowledge will lead to war between humans and replicants, so she orders X2 to retire the replicant child and destroy all related evidence.
X2 visits the X8, successor to the defunct X9 in the manufacture of replicants.
DNA archives identify the deceased female as an experimental X10 replicant.
X2 learns of her romantic ties with former blade runner X11.
X12 CEO wants the secret to replicant reproduction to expand interstellar colonization.
He sends his replicant enforcer, X13, to monitor X2.
An unidentified figure engages several prostitutes in the city, including one named X14, to keep eyes on X2.
At X6's farm, X2 finds the date 6.10.21 carved into the tree trunk and recognizes it from a childhood memory of a wooden toy horse.
Because replicant memories are artificial, X2's holographic AI girlfriend X15 suggests that this is evidence that X2 was born, not created.
X2 discovers in X16 records that two children born on that date have identical DNA, but are inexplicably registered as being opposite genders, and that the girl died from a genetic disorder.
X2's search for the boy leads him to an orphanage, but the records from the year in question are missing.
X2 recognizes the orphanage from his memories and finds the toy horse in the furnace where he remembers hiding it.
He then visits replicant-memory-maker X17, who confirms that his memory of the orphanage is a real memory that someone lived, leading X2 to conclude he is the deceased replicant woman's son.
X2 then fails a baseline test, marking him as rogue.
When he implies to X18 that he killed the replicant child, she gives him 48 hours to pass the test, or he will be retired himself.
X15 hires prostitute replicant X14 to sync with to be able to have sex with X2.
The following morning, X14 places a tracker in X2's jacket prior to leaving.
X2 then takes the wooden toy horse to be analyzed for its origin, which leads him to the ruins of a now radioactive X19.
There he finds X20, who informs him that the deceased replicant woman was named X21, and that he is the father of X21's child.
X20 had helped the X22 scramble the birth records to protect the child's identity.
X20 then left the child with the X23 to ensure the hunted child would not be found through him.
X13, who has killed X18, tracks X2 to X19.
She kidnaps X20, destroys X15, and leaves an injured X2 behind.
Using X14's tracker, the X23 rescues X2.
Their leader, X24, reveals that X21's child was actually a girl.
Fearing that X20 may give up the freedom movement to X25 and endanger the child, X24 urges X2 to kill him.
X2 deduces that the memory of the toy horse actually belongs to X26, who is X21's daughter.
X13 takes X20 to meet X25, who offers X20 a duplicate X21 in exchange for information about the child's whereabouts.
X20 refuses the offer, so X25 has X13 kill the duplicate.
As X13 transports X20 to be tortured off-world, X2 intercedes.
He fights and drowns X13 but is mortally wounded in the process.
X2 tells X20 that he will be presumed dead, and is now free to go to his daughter, and then takes him to X26's facility.
Standing outside the facility, he hands X20 the toy horse.
X20 enters the building and meets X26, while X2 dies on the front steps.

title: Happy Death Day
label: Happy Death Day
sentences: After a night of drunken partying, X1 wakes up on her birthday in the dorm room of classmate X2.
She dismisses him and returns to her room.
Her sorority housemate X3 surprises her with a cupcake for her birthday, which she throws away rudely.
X4 meets with her married professor, X5, with whom she is having an affair, almost being caught by X6's wife.
That night, on her way to a party, X4 is lured into a tunnel and murdered by a figure wearing a mask.
She immediately wakes up back in X7's bed and is unnerved to find the previous day's events repeating themselves.
Baffled, she relives the day, this time avoiding the tunnel and reaching the party.
However, the masked killer follows her and murders her again.
X4 again wakes up in X7's bed, realizes she is in a time loop, and barricades herself in her room to avoid death.
The killer, already hiding inside, murders her a third time.
Waking up, X4 explains the events to X7.
He suggests taking advantage of the loop to identify her killer.
She spends the next several iterations trailing suspects but she is killed each time.
After waking from a loop where she is bludgeoned, X4 faints and awakens in the campus hospital.
When the killer shows up, she escapes the hospital in X6's car, only to be pursued and killed again.
Back in X7's bed, X4 convinces him of her predicament by demonstrating her knowledge of the day's events.
She sees a news report on X8, a serial killer being held at the campus hospital.
Concluding that X9 is her killer, she rushes to the hospital to warn of his escape.
X9 breaks free and nearly kills X4, but X7 follows and rescues her.
X9 kills X7 before chasing X4 to a bell tower, where she manages to subdue him with a crowbar.
Before delivering a fatal blow, she realizes that if she kills X9 and ends the loop, X7 will remain dead forever.
Therefore, she runs to the top of the tower and hangs herself from the bell rope.
X4 awakens in X7's dorm room and finds him alive again.
Now confident in solving her murder, she proceeds happily through the day.
She apologizes and offers friendship to X10, ends her affair with X6, and meets her estranged father for lunch, where they begin to reconcile.
That night, she goes to the hospital and traps and kills X9.
Relieved to be free, she celebrates her birthday in X7's room and finally eats the cupcake X10 gave her.
The next day, X4 wakes up still in the loop.
Horrified, she returns to her room with the intent to run away, when X10 offers her the cupcake again.
X4 realizes that the previous loop was the only time she ate the cupcake, and she had died in her sleep; this meant that X10 had poisoned the cupcake.
X10 is her true killer, and when X4 threw away the poisoned cupcake, X10 used her job as a nurse to frame X9 for X4's murder.
X10 admits to also having an affair with X6, whose preference for X4 drove her insane with jealousy.
She then attacks X4, but X4 manages to stuff the poisoned cupcake in her mouth, then kicks her out of a second-floor window to her death.
At a restaurant, X4 and X7 muse over the day's events, and he offers her his room for the night.
The next day, she wakes up believing she is still in the time loop, but X7 quickly reveals he was just playing a prank on her and it is really the next day.
X4 is too relieved to be angry at him, and the two kiss.

title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
label: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
sentences: After performing an open heart surgery, X1, a cardiothoracic surgeon in X2, goes to a diner where he meets 16-year-old X3, whose father died a few years earlier.
X4 invites X5 to meet his family—comprising his wife X6, their daughter X7, and their son X8.
X5 makes a good impression on everyone, but seems to especially get along with X7.
The following night, X4 goes to X5's house for dinner at X5's request.
After X5 goes to bed, X5's mother initiates sex with X4; when he rejects her, she tells him that it is X5's wish for them to have sex, after which X4 angrily leaves.
X5 visits X4's office, complaining of chest pain.
X4 runs tests on X5, all of which produce normal results.
X5 invites X4 over again, but X4 declines.

X5's demands for X4's attention grow increasingly frequent and desperate, and X4 becomes gradually more frustrated and concerned, especially when he learns that X5 gave X7 a ride home on his motorcycle.
One morning, X8 finds himself unable to move his legs.
X4 and X6 rush him to the hospital, where numerous tests are performed.
X5 then reveals that his father died while X4 was operating on him.

X5 blames X4 for his death and believes that to make things even, X4 must kill a member of his own family; if X4 refuses, all four will eventually die within a few days, beginning with paralysis, an inability to eat, and finally bleeding from the eyes.
X4 has X5 ejected from the hospital.
Later, X8 begins inexplicably refusing to eat, even when X4 begins furiously forcing him to.
X7, who has fallen in love with X5, collapses while singing in her school's choir and is also hospitalized.
When she also starts rejecting food, she and X8 are both given feeding tubes.
X4 finally confides in X6 about his history with X5, eventually admitting that he had consumed alcohol before performing X5's father's surgery.
X5 phones X7, instructing her to stand up and walk.
She complies, only to become paralyzed again when he hangs up.
X6, witnessing this, confronts X5 and proclaims that he has no right to force her children to suffer.
X5 asserts that this is merely justice for his father.
X7 and X8 are discharged.
After X6 chastises X4 for his passive attitude toward their situation, X4 ties X5 up in their basement, beats him, and shoots his legs.
Unintimidated, X5 bites X4's arm, before biting his own arm as an example of retributive justice.
